scientific_question: Can exact cloned control states generate a credible empirical mapping (state/history, action, lag) -> outcome under a frozen controller?

claim_boundary.allowed: Feasibility is operationally scoped to the frozen controller/policy family, physical model, constraints, target, horizon, and action semantics.
forbidden: claiming physical non-viability for the robot in general
fitting a Terrynce scalar or curve before the direct transition model
using outcome results to change the perturbation distribution, action set, lag grid, or target under this experiment ID

reference_model_not_used_in_primary_orac.reason: Reserved for later controller/model robustness. The primary policy is evaluated against the Unitree deployment XML it was released with.

controller.policy_recurrence_assumption: Released motion.pt is a PolicyExporterLSTM artifact. hidden_state and cell_state are mutable TorchScript buffers and are part of every counterfactual snapshot.
controller.recurrent_state_source: unitreerobotics/unitree_rl_gym legged_gym/utils/helpers.py PolicyExporterLSTM registers hidden_state and cell_state and mutates both on every forward call.

fidelity_failure_receipt.disposition: Portable mjSTATE_INTEGRATION reconstruction plus mj_forward is rejected for counterfactual branching in this stack. Full mjData copies are required.

snapshot.scientific_rule: Do not weaken the 1e-12 fidelity tolerance. MuJoCo integration state, deployment-loop state, and recurrent LSTM hidden/cell state must remain identical under identical replay.

fidelity_failure_receipt_run3.diagnosis: MuJoCo cloning alone was insufficient because the released policy is recurrent and shared mutable LSTM memory was not branch-local.

context_generation.selection: deterministic seeded draw from the frozen grid; no outcome-adaptive boundary hunting
context_generation.snapshot_time: immediately after perturbation force/torque is cleared and mj_forward is called

lag_semantics: During lag, the cloned wrapper continues with the pre-intervention command. The intervention command becomes active at the first policy update at or after the exact frozen lag.

failure_if: base height < 0.45 m at any time after intervention becomes active
projected gravity z > -0.35 at any time after intervention becomes active
success_if: during final 0.30 s: median base height >= 0.60 m
during final 0.30 s: median projected-gravity horizontal norm <= 0.45
rollout.ground_truth: deterministic binary rollout outcome; model probabilities are not used in Stage A

next_stage_only_if_pass: Freeze state-level train/validation/holdout split by context_id and benchmark a direct action-conditioned transition learner. No branches from one context may cross splits.
